jobs_results.title: QA Test Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are currently seeking a talented QA Engineer to uphold the exceptional quality of our industry-leading products. While manual testing remains a primary focus, we also harness the power of automated testing. This role necessitates outstanding time management, effective communication skills, and the ability to work independently while maintaining close collaboration with internal design teams.

Key Responsibilities:

· Verification and Validation Testing: Conduct rigorous verification and validation testing for new hardware and software products.

· Test Planning: Develop detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases to ensure thorough quality assurance.

· Automation Testing: Design, develop, and execute automation tests to enhance testing efficiency.

· Risk Analysis: Contribute to the analysis by anticipating project risks and providing effective mitigations.

Skills:

· Degree in a relevant engineering subject or equivalent.

· You must have a... background/good understanding of hardware and electronics.

· Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.

· Strong computing skills and an aptitude for learning advanced software.

· Analytical skills, including the ability to understand and reason about complex information.

· Ability to work independently under guidance.

Desirable extras:

· Technical experience working in lab instrumentation industries.

· Experience in writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases.

· Coding experience with React, Typescript, Python.

· Familiarity with automated GUI testing systems.

We offer:

· Competitive salary.

· Professional career growing environment.

· Workplace camaraderie.

· Flexible schedule and hours bank

jobs_results.title: Software testing engineer
jobs_results.description:
If the phrase “Gotta Catch ’Em All… all the bugs” makes you smile, your place is at GMV!

The AIV Satellite Control Center team that participates in projects such as Galileo: 'The European GPS', or MTG and EPS: meteorological satellites among others, is looking for new additions!

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website.

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In this amazing team you will be able to understand how communication with satellites works. You will have access to very realistic simulators! This will allow you to work under the same conditions as the operators and get the most out of the system.

You will be able to get involved in the entire software validation process from the definition of the initial tasks to the delivery and acceptance of the final product, participating in:
• Analisys of requirements.
• Define and write test procedures.
• Development and configuration of tools to automate... tests.
• Communication with clients and stakeholders.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for engineering graduates with an interest in the world of software testing and validation software.

We will also value previous experience and knowledge in:
• Complex and distributed systems (Linux operating system)
• Participation in test campaigns: planning, preparation, execution, reports.
• Knowledge of V&V related tools (DOORS, Jira, Git...)
• Programming languages like Python.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

Clara Sanchez Lobato

jobs_results.title: Expert Embedded Software Test Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Daikin Europe N.V. is the European headquarters of the Japanese company, Daikin Industries Ltd. We design, manufacture, and distribute air conditioning and heating systems for commercial, residential, and industrial applications. Our headquarters are located in Brussels, Gent, and Ostend, but through our sales networks, we also have a presence throughout Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. We are the market leader in the field of air conditioning and also offer Total Comfort Solutions in the fields of cooling, heating, ventilation, and related techniques. As a company, we are constantly expanding with extensive international contacts, providing a pleasant, stimulating working environment, and offering extensive training and coaching. Daikin Europe N.V. values highly motivated employees and is always looking for new talent.

Department:

The EMEA Electrics and Control department was created shortly after the establishment of the European Development Center (EDC). It is one of the... fastest-growing departments aimed at facilitating and ensuring the strong future growth of Daikin. The department is located in Gent, Technology Park, and plays a crucial role in developing embedded software & hardware as well as cloud and app development. This year we want to expend our 2nd office in Madrid.

Role Overview:

As an Expert Embedded Software Test Engineer at Daikin Europe N.V., you will lead our embedded software testing efforts, utilizing your deep technical expertise and industry experience to drive continuous improvement in testing strategies and methodologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of robust, high-quality embedded software solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the design and implementation of embedded software testing strategies, methodologies, and best practices.
• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software systems, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
• Collaborate with the development team of the automated test framework to set requirements and direction of the automation platform.
• Report defects to the development teams and where needed assist in the root cause analysis with them.
• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior members of the embedded software testing team, fostering their growth and development.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and prioritize testing requirements, and ensure alignment with project timelines and objectives.
• Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in embedded software testing, and proactively identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.

Requirements:
• Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in embedded software testing, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience with Automatic testing of embedded software.
• Expertise in developing and executing test plans and test cases for embedded software systems, including experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex software issues and identify effective solutions.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
• Passion for learning and professional growth, with a commitment to staying current with industry trends and advancements.
• knowledge of: Jenkins, RobotFramework & git is a plus.
• programming skills in languages commonly used for embedded software development (e.g., C/C++, Python) is a plus.
• In-depth knowledge of embedded systems architectures, communication protocols, and hardware/software interfaces is a plus.
• Experience with embedded software development tools and debugging techniques (e.g., IDEs, JTAG debuggers) is a plus.
• experience with heating systems, heatpumps and controls of such systems is a plus.

Join us at Daikin Europe N.V. and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of embedded software testing and delivering innovative solutions that make a difference

jobs_results.title: 🇪🇸 SOFTWARE TEST & VALIDATION ENGINEER
jobs_results.description:
DOGA has more than 60 years of experience in the development and production of automotive components. With affiliated companies in Italy, USA, Mexico, Brazil, China, India and Morocco we sale our products to more than 70 countries and operate in multiple markets, including industrial vehicles, buses, trains, agriculture and construction machinery, boats, motorcycles and passenger cars.

We are looking for a Software Test & Validation Engineer, reporting directly to Electronic Systems Manager. As a member of DOGA's electronic systems department, he/she will validate the software of new developments for electronic engines and control units to ensure their proper functioning.

Essential Tasks
• Perform specification studies.
• Design tests and documentation.
• Prepare tests and develop resources.
• Execute and report tests.
• Collaborate closely with the electronic product engineering department.

Profile Required
• Electronics Engineering, or similar.
• At least 2 years of experience in... a similar position.
• Knowledge of C or Python languages.
• Experience with Vector tools (CAN, LIN communication protocols).
• Valuable knowledge of Altium for schematics and layouts consulting and interpretation.
• Valuable knowledge of LabVIEW programming and instrumentation, as well as laboratory equipment.
• Valuable experience with implementation of FCT, ICT and EoL verification for the HW.
• Valuable knowledge of the automotive functional safety ISO 26262.
• High level of both oral and written English.
• Proactivity, resolution and decision-making, high creativity.
• Ability to work both autonomously and in multidisciplinary teams.

What We Offer
• 🚀 Join a Thriving Company: Work for a rapidly growing and strategically positioned company.
• ⏰ Flexible Work Schedule: Enjoy flexible working hours and the option for a Friday afternoon off.
• 💻 Hybrid Work Model: Experience a hybrid work environment that combines office and remote work.
• 😀 Customizable Benefits Package: Take advantage of a flexible payment plan that includes options such as kindergarten support, education benefits, transport allowances, gourmet vouchers, or medical insurance.
• 👋 Dynamic Team Environment: Collaborate in active work environment alongside a team of highly qualified and dedicated professionals.
• 🌍 Inclusive Culture: Thrive in an inclusive culture that values diversity, where all individuals, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, abilities, or gender identity, feel respected and valued.

If you are interested in joining our DOGA team, do not hesitate to apply. We will be happy to talk to you

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Would you like to join an international atmosphere and being involved in projects across Europe and with impact worldwide having the opportunity to consolidate your career? This is your opportunity!

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team!

Within the New IT HUB Sales - Retail of the Future supporting the strategic Mercedes Benz Program we need a Quality Assurance Engineer.

The Quality Assurance Engineer role within Mercedes-Benz is responsible for planning, executing, and automating testing efforts while ensuring alignment with program requirements. This role leverages technical knowledge related to test automation, cloud services (AWS, Azure), data mesh architectures, and data engineering.

Description of role and responsibilities
• Professionalize testing and test automations together with the head of testing in VdZ program.
• Increase quality and coverage of testing and of test automation.
• Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts... ensuring comprehensive test coverage and reliability.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, and program management, to align testing efforts with program objectives.
• Design and maintain test automation frameworks, optimizing testing processes and increasing efficiency.
• Test within cloud environments (AWS, Azure), addressing unique testing challenges in cloud-based solutions and ensuring data consistency.
• Utilize industry-standard tools for test automation and test management to streamline testing efforts.
• Facilitate communication between testing teams, development teams, data professionals, and other stakeholders to ensure successful testing within the program.
• Embrace Agile program management practices to align testing efforts with program goals and drive continuous improvement, emphasizing data-driven integration and data consistency within the program's environment.

Education degree & technical experience
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a STEM related field.
• Relevant certifications, such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) or AWS Certified Developer, are advantageous.
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in software testing, test automation, and cloud services (AWS, Azure) within the program environment.

Technical knowledge/Accountabilities
• Extensive knowledge in test automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices.
• Strong understanding of cloud services (AWS, Azure) and their impact on testing processes.
• Familiarity with program-level testing, integration, data mesh architectures, and data engineering.
• Knowledge of industry-standard tools for test automation and test management, as well as proficiency in software testing methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall.
• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans and strategies.

Experience
• 5 years of proven experience in test planning, execution, and automation, ensuring alignment with program requirements.
• Successful collaboration with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, and program management, to ensure test coverage and reliability.
• Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain test automation frameworks, optimizing testing processes.
• Expertise in testing within cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and addressing unique testing challenges in cloud-based solutions.
• Knowledge of program-level testing practices and Agile program management to align testing efforts with program objectives.
• Diverse experiences with the software testing life cycle following a globally recognized testing methodology, including user acceptance tests, system tests, and system integration tests.
• First-hand experience in state-of-the-art development practices (CI/CD, end-to-end testing, etc.)

English:
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Knowledge of the German language is a plus.

Other Preferences

In addition to technical expertise, the ideal candidate should possess a set of vital soft skills for the role, including agility to swiftly adapt to evolving situations, a strong sense of empowerment, fostering trust and inspiration, a co-creative mindset that thrives on collaborative innovation, a relentless drive to excel and achieve success, unwavering customer orientation aimed at continually delighting our clients, a deep-rooted sense of purpose, a pioneering spirit that embraces innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of industry advancements. All these skills are included as People Principles in the Mercedes-Benz career path for our continuous development

We offer you the opportunity to grow in an international and dynamic environment, taking part in new projects.

Within our benefits as employee, we provide:
• Competitive salary + variable compensation
• Mobile work
• Flexible entering hours
• 30 working days of holidays
• Annual Training Plan
• Mercedes-Benz benefits (Renting plans, employee discount

jobs_results.title: Gestor/a Testing (Automoción)
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

¿Eres Ingeniero/a y te interesa seguir desarrollándote en la parte de gestión en el sector automoción? ¿Dispones de experiencia en testing dentro del Sector?

Desde RDT Ingenieros tenemos el objetivo de que nuestros trabajadores disfruten de la ingeniería y que tengan oportunidad de crecer profesional y personalmente.

Actualmente, incorporamos un/a GESTOR/A TESTING (AUTOMOCIÓN) en Abrera.

Tu misión
• Serás el interlocutor con diferentes equipos de cliente (comunicación en inglés)
• Gestión, organización de los diferentes hitos del proyecto a través de JIRA
• Gestión y organización de los equipos de testing.
• Ejecución de campañas de pruebas y análisis de fallos.
• Reporte de los resultados obtenidos.
• Puesta en marcha y mantenimiento de las herramientas y sistemas involucrados en el proceso de ejecución.
• Asistencia a reuniones de status de proyecto (en inglés), colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Acompañamiento desde el primer día: nos... gusta cuidar de nuestros/as ingenieros/as.

Estabilidad y tranquilidad laboral: es importante para nosotros/as que sepas que todas nuestras posiciones son estables.

Retribución flexible donde se podrán adquirir servicios como: Seguro Médico, Ticket Guardería, Campus Virtual con Formación a tu disposición ¡entre otros!

Planes en Gympass: gimnasios a precios reducidos.

Requisitos mínimos
• Formación en Ingeniería.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año realizando funciones similares.
• Idiomas. Inglés avanzado.
• Conocimiento en sistemas de comunicación automotriz (CAN, LIN, FLEXRay) y/o funciones ADAS, ORU or CONNECTED CAR del vehículo.
• Experiencia y/o conocimiento trabajando con CANoe/CANape yEthernet y conocimiento de Jira para tareas de ticketing.

En RDT Ingenieros somos una empresa innovadora cuyo ámbito de actuación es el desarrollo de proyectos de ingeniería avanzados, trabajando en sectores como: Aeronáutica, Aeroespacial, Automoción, Energía, Industria, Petroquímica, Bienes de Equipo, Bienes de Consumo y muchos más, en función de la zona geográfica en la que estamos ubicados

Estabilidad y tranquilidad laboral: es importante para nosotros/as que sepas que todas nuestras posiciones son estables.

Retribución flexible donde se podrán adquirir servicios como: Seguro Médico, Ticket Guardería, Campus Virtual con Formación a tu disposición ¡entre otros!

Planes en Gympass: gimnasios a precios reducidos.

• Formación en Ingeniería.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año realizando funciones similares.

CT impulsa los límites de la tecnología a través de la innovación, y lleva la eficiencia a otro nivel cubriendo todo el ciclo de vida de los productos, desde el diseño y la fabricación hasta el soporte postventa. Con más de 30 años de experiencia, el éxito de CT está impulsado hoy en día por más de 1.800 ingenieros expertos repartidos en siete países, en tres continentes.

Actualmente estamos buscando incorporar Ingeniero/as electronicos para diferentes proyectos de automoción en las empresas más importantes del sector en Barcelona.
• Llevar a cabo Validaciones de EV y Baterías, analizar y presentar resultados.

• Participar o asistir en eventos relacionados con EV Charging por diferentes zonas de Europa
• Estudios en... Ingeniería Electrónica o similar
• Conocimiento de coche eléctrico, preparación del vehículo para los test.

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (3 días presenciales y 2 días de teletrabajo).

• Clima laboral participativo, inclusivo y dinámico. ¡Nos encanta trabajar en equipo!
• Formar parte del lugar donde los ingenieros aman trabajar.

Buscamos una persona proactiva, motivada, con ganas de seguir creciendo en el mundo industrial, con ganas de nuevos retos dentro del mundo tecnológico.

jobs_results.title: SW testing engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you are one of those who, after parking, double checks that you have locked the car...Your place is at GMV!

We are expanding our teams in the space sector to be part of the Galileo project, 'The European GPS'.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website.

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our Galileo SKMF team you will be able to learn about one of the elements that control security in the field of satellite control and be part of the development of functions such as:
• Execution and evolution of software validation tests, continuous validation of the element, integration, acceptance and non-regression tests.
• Test automation through different tools, script development.
• Evolution of the project's testing tools and definition of new test cases.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for computer engineering graduates with knowledge in:
• Testing and validation of SW and... systems based on requirements.
• Operating Systems: Unix
• Script generation (shell script, python)
• Automation: UFT One, selenium, postman.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Presential working model.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

Clara Sanchez Lobato

jobs_results.title: Network testing engineer Galileo
jobs_results.description:
Do you like network testing and are you looking for a project that motivates you?

If you like to carry out tests, your site is in GMV!

We are expanding our Network Validation team for the Galileo project, 'The European GPS'.

We like to get to the point, so we're going to tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about GMV: www.gmv.com/en-es/about-gmv

WHAT CHALLENGE ARE YOU GOING TO FACE?

In our incredible and amazing crew you will support the Galileo validation team, where you will learn all the elements that make up a control center and you will perform tasks such as tests with satellite control center network equipment.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for engineering profiles with an interest in the world of testing. We will also value previous experience and knowledge in:
• Linux operating system
• LAN/WAN networks (switches, firewalls, VPNs)
• Participation in test campaigns: planning, preparation, execution, reports.

We will... value knowledge or interest in:
• Management of requirements and/or tests, such as DOORS, qTest, test link or test rail -
• Incident/ticket management, such as Jira, Bugzilla or Redmine -
• Scripting, such as bash or python.
• Communications protocols in networks, applications to measure performance and network bottlenecks.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

💻 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

🕑 Flexible start and finish times and intensive working hours on Fridays and summer.

🚀 Personalised career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Coming from another country? We offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive remuneration with ongoing reviews, flexible remuneration and brand discounts.

💪Wellbeing programme: medical, dental and accident insurance, free fruit and coffee, training in physical, mental and financial health, and much more!

In our selection processes, you will always have telephone and personal contact, in person or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted by any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com.

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment and are committed to inclusion and diversity.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About EVPassport

EVPassport is the technological evolution of EV charging software and hardware for forward-thinking companies around the world who place high value on the satisfaction of their customers. Developed with a deep understanding of Enterprise SaaS, our team establishes solutions best fit your business needs.

We operate in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, and we offer a leading end-to-end EV Charging solution to enterprise businesses.

EVPassport is changing the EV Charging experience, and we want you to help build it.

Your Job Opportunity

At EVPassport we are looking for a detailed-oriented QA Automation Engineer. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our electric vehicle (EV) charging platform, being responsible for planning, executing, and automating testing for our software and mobile applications to deliver an experience that exceeds our customers' expectations.

Location:

Poblenou, Barcelona. Hybrid work mode.

You Will
•... Collaborate with the development and product teams to understand project requirements, features, and user stories. Develop test plans and strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage for new functionalities and enhancements.
• Conduct various types of testing, including functional, regression, performance, and usability testing, to identify and report defects and issues in the software and hardware components.
• Design and implement automated test scripts to increase testing efficiency and coverage. Continuously improve test automation frameworks to enhance the effectiveness of automated tests.
• Utilize bug-tracking systems to document and manage defects throughout the testing lifecycle. Work closely with the development team to resolve issues and verify bug fixes.
• Ensure the compatibility of EVPassport applications and software with different devices, browsers, and operating systems.
• Perform load and stress testing to assess system performance, scalability, and stability, identifying potential bottlenecks and areas for improvement.
• Actively participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance the overall software development and testing process.
• Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including test cases, test scripts, and test reports.

You Have
• +4 years of experience in test automation.
• Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
• Experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium).
• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter) is a plus.
• Understanding of agile software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum).
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with great attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Passion for electric vehicles and sustainable transportation is a plus.

Our Values
• Customer Obsessed
• Trust by Default
• Own the Outcome
• Growth Mindset
• Anything is Possible
• Practice Kindness

Our Benefits:
• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
• Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
• Hybrid working model (own your time)
• Stock Option Plan

Apply now if you thrive in an environment that grants you the autonomy to explore and build solutions.

For additional information on EVPassport, please visit https://www.evpassport.com
